aboutDescription: A digital cookbook for your recipes, shared cooking workspaces and weekly meal plans.
aboutBody: Save recipes with photos, structured ingredients and steps. Invite members to a private workspace, plan lunches and dinners, and save favorites. Public submissions and their language versions are reviewed by a moderator before publication. Personal notes and workspace conversations stay private.
contactDescription: Questions about the application and published recipes can be directed to the operator.
contactMissing: Contact details have not been published yet.
privacyDescription: How Moja kuhinja handles data and essential cookies.
privacyBody: Only explicitly submitted and approved copies of recipes, photographs and attribution are public. Private recipes, personal notes, workspace comments, email addresses and memberships are not part of the public cookbook. Accounts and content are stored in the application's database, with images in the operator's local storage.
privacyCookies: The app uses essential session cookies for login and security, and a cookie for your saved language preference. Google Analytics, advertising tracking and external analytics SDKs are not included. Signed-in readers' opens count at most once per recipe per day; this counter does not track anonymous readers.

inviteOnly: Registration currently requires a valid invitation. Ask the person who introduced you to the app, or the operator, for an invitation. If you already have one, open the link you received. Existing users can sign in.
